nodes.description: mapping(address=>bool) _enable: whitelist controlling which accounts may transfer tokens to _uni
address _uni: destination address that triggers the whitelist check in _beforeTokenTransfer
address private _owner: privileged account set from _msgSender() in the constructor
uint256 private _totalSupply: token supply read by the cap check and decremented on burn
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances: token balances updated in _transfer/_mint/_burn
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances: spender approvals
StakeBONE(address user, bool enable) public onlyOwner: toggles _enable[user]
MigrateUNI(address uni_) public onlyOwner: reassigns the _uni checkpoint address
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual override: hook enforcing _enable[from] when to == _uni
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual override: enforces 1e9*1e18 cap then calls super._mint
constructor of YOSHI: mints the initial supply and whitelists the initial holder
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public virtual: external entry point delegating to _transfer
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public virtual: allowance-based transfer moving tokens through _transfer then _approve
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual: balance bookkeeping and hook invocation
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual: reduces balance and total supply
onlyOwner modifier: require(owner() == _msgSender()) guarding privileged functions
msg.sender surfaced through Context._msgSender(): caller identity used for ownership checks and transfer authorization
State write _enable[user] = enable in StakeBONE: privileged mutation of the transfer whitelist
require(_enable[from]) gate inside _beforeTokenTransfer: access-control check keyed on caller-supplied 'from' and the owner-controlled _uni
require(ERC20.totalSupply() + amount <= 1000000000 *10**18): arithmetic supply-cap check in YOSHI._mint
_totalSupply -= amount in _burn: arithmetic decrement of the total supply
user: address key written into the _enable mapping by StakeBONE
enable: boolean flag stored into _enable[user] by StakeBONE
uni_: address assigned to the _uni state variable by MigrateUNI
from: source address used as the key of the _enable lookup in _beforeTokenTransfer
to: destination address compared against _uni in _beforeTokenTransfer
amount: transferred amount passed to _beforeTokenTransfer (unused by the hook body)
account: recipient of newly minted tokens in _mint
amount: quantity minted, used in the supply-cap arithmetic
recipient: destination address of transfer
amount: quantity moved by transfer
sender: debited address in transferFrom
recipient: credited address in transferFrom
amount: quantity moved by transferFrom
currentAllowance: cached allowance read from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] in transferFrom
senderBalance: cached balance read from _balances[sender] in _transfer

edges.reason: Constructor stores _msgSender() into the _owner state variable, so caller identity determines ownership
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender(), making msg.sender the authorization input
onlyOwner gates execution of StakeBONE, restricting whitelist mutation to the owner
onlyOwner gates execution of MigrateUNI, restricting _uni reassignment to the owner
StakeBONE body performs the privileged _enable[user] = enable state write
The _enable write mutates the whitelist mapping used by the transfer hook
MigrateUNI assigns uni_ into the _uni state variable, changing which destination triggers the whitelist check
_beforeTokenTransfer executes the whitelist require statement on every hooked transfer
The require condition reads _uni to decide whether the whitelist gate applies
The require condition reads _enable[from], letting the owner whitelist arbitrary senders
YOSHI._mint enforces the totalSupply() + amount <= cap arithmetic check
The cap check reads _totalSupply through ERC20.totalSupply()
_burn executes the _totalSupply -= amount arithmetic decrement
The decrement mutates the _totalSupply state variable
transfer delegates token movement to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom delegates token movement to the internal _transfer routine
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook, the callback point where whitelist/state semantics can be influenced
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the debited sender, so caller identity drives balance movement
transferFrom reads _msgSender() to look up and reduce the caller's allowance
transferFrom loads the stored allowance into the currentAllowance local variable
currentAllowance is read from the _allowances mapping
transferFrom reads and rewrites _allowances via _approve after subtracting the spent amount
_transfer caches the sender balance into the senderBalance local variable
senderBalance is read from the _balances mapping before the debit
The user parameter is used as the key of the _enable[user] = enable write
The enable parameter is the value stored into the _enable whitelist mapping
The uni_ parameter is directly assigned to the _uni state variable
The from parameter keys the _enable lookup inside the require gate
The to parameter is compared against _uni to decide whether the whitelist require fires
The amount parameter feeds the supply-cap arithmetic expression
transfer's amount parameter is forwarded into _transfer
transferFrom's amount parameter is forwarded into _transfer
The constructor calls the overridden _mint to create the initial supply
The constructor whitelists the initial holder by writing _enable at deploy time
The account parameter is the mint recipient passed to super._mint

normalization_plan.reason: user is a StakeBONE input consumed only by the privileged _enable write, so it can be folded into the enclosing function
enable is a StakeBONE input whose only role is the whitelist flag stored by the function
uni_ is the single MigrateUNI input directly assigned to the _uni state variable
from is the hook input used as the _enable lookup key inside the require
to is the hook input compared with _uni to gate the whitelist require
amount is a hook input that does not affect the whitelist branch and can be absorbed by the function
account is the mint target passed straight through to super._mint
amount is the operand of the totalSupply() + amount <= cap arithmetic check
recipient is the transfer destination forwarded to _transfer
amount is the transfer quantity forwarded to _transfer
sender is the debited address of transferFrom and must remain scoped to it
recipient is the credited address of transferFrom, meaningless outside it
amount is the transferFrom quantity used both for the allowance subtraction and _transfer
currentAllowance is a temporary computation local to transferFrom's allowance bookkeeping
senderBalance is a temporary caching variable local to the internal _transfer routine
